name: MaxBot (team design notes, MODEL numbers, no CAD yet)
frame: robot frame: +x forward, +y left, z up, origin at the robot centre on the floor. Shooter/camera x,y,z are relative to the turret pivot with the turret at 0 deg.

provenance_legend.vault: from the team's MaxBot design notes (Memory Vault 'MaxBot Design'/'MaxBot Requirements'): MODEL or SAID, no CAD exists yet
provenance_legend.placeholder: guess for looks, replace from CAD

prov_note: Each object may carry a 'prov' map {key: tag, '*': default tag}. A number takes the tag of its own key, else '*' of the nearest enclosing prov map.

gearing.note: MaxBot Design (Memory Vault, MODEL, no CAD): '5203 1150 rpm at 24:48, 575 wheel rpm, 104 mm GripForce'. motor/gearbox are motor-model ids (physics/motor-model/params.js MOTORS, GEARBOXES): bare 5203 6000 rpm [sourced goBILDA], 5.2:1 cartridge = 57/11 = 5.1818 [sourced goBILDA formula], belt 24T:48T = 2.0 [vault]. Overall 10.364 motor rev per wheel rev, 579 wheel rpm free, 124.1 in/s free surface speed at 2.047 in wheel radius. Read by physics_glue.js driveGearingFromSpec for all three physical drive models and the battery-sag drive load.

drive.reconciliation: ASSUMED, recomputed 2026-11-22 from the gearing above (was 60 in/s and 3.2 rad/s placeholders, about half of what the gearing allows). Full-stick steady state after 3 s at 120 Hz, 31.4 lb, fresh 12 V: mecanum-dynamics 114.6 in/s forward, 90.3 in/s strafe, 9.42 rad/s turn; wheel-friction 114.5 in/s forward, 10.80 rad/s turn; motor-model 123.6 in/s (it has no rolling resistance, so it sits at the 124.1 in/s free speed). maxSpeedInS = 114 and maxTurnRadS = 9.4 take the two models with floor losses. maxAccel stays the 140 in/s^2 placeholder: the physical models are traction-limited by an ASSUMED mu 0.7 (about 270 in/s^2), so a measured value is needed. Replace all three with the Pedro tuner numbers (xVelocity, forwardZeroPowerAcceleration) once the robot runs.

physics.note: Default physics-model switches for the sim (web/js/physics_glue.js). All are integrator choices [assumed], not robot measurements; the Physics panel overrides them per viewer. fixedHz [Hz]: 60 matches autorunner.js FIXED_DT = 1/60. Drive mass/wheel radius/spacing come from chassis.mass_lb and wheels[*] above; gearing for every physical drive model (motor, dynamics, friction) and the battery-sag drive load comes from drive.gearing. robotCollision stays legacy and imuModel stays basic (see tests_js/integration/round2.test.mjs for the measured reasons).
